items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: The interviewer addresses Harold directly ('Harold, are you going to die?', 'Harold, I reckon we ought to go') while the interviewee (Roger Mitchell) is present and responding to the interviewer, but there is no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Roger and Harold in the te

ctx.x: I didn't know that, at the wake. I didn't know that, I knew that they go to the great heart.
When I die, you come see. Oh yeah? Harold, are you going to die?
You're not going to die. You're still a mason?
